verdict.rationale: Workable's features page documents one-submission multiposting to 200+ job boards, which covers the core fan-out part of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers sponsored or paid post management, and LinkedIn and Indeed are never named. Missing for 10: sponsored/paid-post management inside the ATS, explicit confirmation of LinkedIn, Indeed and aggregator coverage, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Post your job to 200+ job boards simultaneously, reaching a wider audience with a single submission.
